confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a web search that returned the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living sources found in search. Those sources gave a cappuccino of about CHF 5, a domestic beer of about CHF 6-9, an inexpensive meal of about CHF 20-30 (one source gave CHF 44.80 including a drink), and a mid-range meal for two of about CHF 60-100. I converted these at roughly 1.25 USD per CHF and set the mid-range meal for two above the low end of that range because Lucerne's restaurants run about 18% above the Swiss average. The search found no Lucerne cocktail price. The cocktail figure is inferred from the local beer price and Swiss hotel-bar levels. Wine by the glass is based on Schweizerhof Luzern menu prices of about CHF 10-11 per 10 cl, adjusted down for typical restaurants. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak summer and were not searched or checked against live listings. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Zurich and Swiss tourist cities generally. Lucerne is slightly above the Swiss average for restaurants and has strong summer tourism demand.
